d: Defenders are vital for keeping things tight in close Pro Kabaddi matches where the raiders might look to slow down the pace of the game and play on do-or-die raids. In this throwback video, we take a look at a few of the best defensive masterclasses by defenders on the Pro Kabaddi stage.
